map.M蛋白（血清蛋白电泳）鉴定器 使用指南: M-Protein (Serum Protein Electrophoresis) Identifier User Guide
map.上传或填写血清蛋白电泳与免疫固定结果，自动解读 M 蛋白峰的位置与大小，辅助鉴别: Upload or enter serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation results to automatically interpret the position and size of the M-protein peak, helping distinguish myeloma and other monoclonal gammopathies.
map.血清蛋白电泳见 M 峰，按浓度与类型定 MGUS/SMM/MM: An M peak on serum protein electrophoresis, graded MGUS/SMM/MM by concentration and type
map.算 κ/λ 轻链比值判断单克隆偏倚: Compute the kappa/lambda light chain ratio to judge monoclonal skewing
map.结合 CRAB 与骨髓浆细胞评估是否多发性骨髓瘤: Assess for multiple myeloma combining CRAB and bone marrow plasma cells
map.：M 蛋白分级：<15 g/L 多为 MGUS；15–30 需鉴别 MGUS 与: : M protein grading: below 15 g/L is mostly MGUS; 15-30 needs distinguishing MGUS from smoldering (SMM, plasma cells at least 10% and no CRAB); at least 30 strongly suggests multiple myeloma (requires bone marrow plasma cells at least 10% plus CRAB). Normal kappa/lambda ratio is 0.26-1.65, and deviation suggests monoclonal light chain skewing. Auxiliary: globulin = total protein − albumin, M share % = M / total protein × 100%.
map.：例（总蛋白 75、白蛋白 35、M 蛋白 25、κ=500、λ=30）：球蛋白: : example (total protein 75, albumin 35, M protein 25, kappa = 500, lambda = 30): globulin = 75 − 35 = 40 g/L, kappa/lambda = 500/30 = 16.67 (elevated, kappa skewing), M share = 25/75 × 100 = 33.3%; M in the 15-30 range -> bone marrow aspiration is needed to distinguish MGUS from smoldering MM, and if plasma cells are at least 10% with no CRAB it is classified SMM.
map.通常不需，但需定期随访（约 1%/年进展为 MM 或相关病）；出现 CRAB 表: Usually not, but regular follow-up is needed (about 1%/year progress to MM or a related disease); reassess if CRAB features appear, M protein rises markedly, or the light chain ratio deviates extremely.
map.κ/λ 比值正常却被判单克隆？: Normal kappa/lambda ratio yet flagged as monoclonal?
map.可能。少数情况下总轻链比值正常而免疫固定见单一轻链条带（如轻链型分泌少）；比值仅: Possible. Rarely the total light chain ratio is normal while immunofixation shows a single light chain band (for example light-chain-only disease with low secretion); the ratio is only an aid, and diagnosis rests on electrophoresis/immunofixation combined with free light chains.
